codex.legend.title: Provenance tiers
codex.tier.inferred.aria: Inferred: not observed directly, but constrained by science from measured values
codex.tier.generated.aria: Generated: plausible fill from physical rules where there is no data
codex.tier.measured.explain: Directly observed and catalogued: a measurement you could look up, with its uncertainty.
codex.tier.inferred.explain: Not observed directly, but constrained by physics from measured values. A careful estimate, not a photograph.
codex.tier.generated.explain: Plausible fill from physical rules where no data exist. Seeded, so every player sees the same thing, but invented.
